from pathlib import Path
import json, re, shutil
b=Path('.local/codex-transcription-research')
r=json.loads((b/'chromium-probe-result.json').read_text())
def words(s): return re.findall(r'[\w]+',s)
print(json.dumps({'httpStatus':r['httpStatus'],'requestMs':r['elapsedMs'],'totalMs':r['totalElapsedMs'],'wordsMatch':words(r['expected'])==words(r['transcript']),'apiKeyUsed':r['apiKeyUsed'],'hasWords':r['hasWords'],'hasSegments':r['hasSegments']},ensure_ascii=False))
route=Path('classic/apps/web/src/app/api/transcription/chromium-probe/route.ts')
route.unlink();route.parent.rmdir()
shutil.rmtree(b/'electron-runtime')
if (b/'probe-electron-profile').exists(): shutil.rmtree(b/'probe-electron-profile')
print('Removed temporary route and extracted runtime/profile; retained sanitized results, fixture and diagnostic source.')
